verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents its own event-triggered rules: escalation policies that decide who is alerted and in what order until an incident is acknowledged, complex escalation rules based on time, team availability and incident origin, and automatic actions on new incidents such as posting a todo list and routing to a responder. The available actions are documented mainly for alerting, escalation and routing, not as a general rule-to-action automation engine. missing for 10: a general-purpose event-to-action workflow builder with arbitrary actions, documented trigger and condition types beyond incident alerting, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: An escalation policy is a custom set of rules for incident alerting, ideal for creating advanced incident alerting processes.
